name: Scotch Ridge Berry and Tree Farm
tagline: Scotch Ridge Berry and Tree Farm
description: Scotch Ridge Berry and Tree Farm grows Blueberries, Herbs, Flowers, and Christmas trees in Duanesburg, NY. The farm is small, and its seasons run through summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
